"""rcb-limited/2.0 client — the only thing a limited-mode agent gets (installed at /opt/tools/rcb_client.py).

    from rcb_client import Robot
    r = Robot()                                   # finds the service (sim:8000, then localhost:8000), waits for warm-up
    spec = r.spec()                               # action types + dims + limits, cameras, budgets
    obs = r.get_obs()                             # current frames: obs.last["head_camera"] -> uint8 HxWx3, obs.meta["proprio"]
    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.05)    # actions: (T, 14); returns the execution video
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", actions)                    # (T, 16); planner per row (see spec)
    res.video["head_camera"]  -> mp4 bytes     res.frames["head_camera"] -> uint8 (N,H,W,3) if video="frames"/"both"
    res.last["left_camera"]   -> uint8 HxWx3   res.proprio -> float32 (N, 30)   res.meta -> dict (done, plan, clipped, ...)
    res.save("/app/runs/003")                  # meta.json, <cam>.mp4, frames/<cam>/NNN.jpg, last/<cam>.jpg, proprio.npy
    obs = r.get_obs(seconds=3, video="both")   # hold the last command, let physics run 3 s, return the video

Nothing is put into your context automatically: what you look at, and where you store it, is your code's decision.

    def get_obs(self, cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera"), seconds: float = 0.0,

+"""RoboTwin 2.0 hanging_mug limited-mode trajectory controller."""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+RUNS = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+RUNS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+obs = r.get_obs(cameras=("head_camera", "front_camera", "left_camera", "right_camera",
+                         "observer_camera", "world_camera1"),
+                include_depth=True, video="none")
+obs.save(str(RUNS / "000_start"))
+print("SPEC", json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+print("META", json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+
+def current_poses(observation=obs):
+    now = observation.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    return [np.array(now[14:21], dtype=float), np.array(now[21:28], dtype=float)]
+
+def pose_row(left=None, right=None, left_grip=None, right_grip=None, observation=obs):
+    poses = current_poses(observation)
+    now = observation.meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    if left is not None:
+        poses[0] = np.array(left, dtype=float)
+    if right is not None:
+        poses[1] = np.array(right, dtype=float)
+    lg = now[28] if left_grip is None else left_grip
+    rg = now[29] if right_grip is None else right_grip
+    return np.r_[poses[0], lg, poses[1], rg].astype(np.float32)
+
+def move(left=None, right=None, left_grip=None, right_grip=None, note="", video="mp4"):
+    global obs
+    row = pose_row(left, right, left_grip, right_grip, obs)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", row, note=note, video=video)
+    name = f"{len(list(RUNS.iterdir())):03d}_{note[:28].replace(' ', '_')}"
+    res.save(str(RUNS / name))
+    obs = res
+    print("RESULT", json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    return res
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
